first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and memory_86 demonstrated that shortening onboarding lifted completion and early adoption. memory_31 showed signup simplification improved SMB activation. Verifying these two will confirm whether field reduction and flow compression can address the current activation/onboarding decline without the retention damage that memory_73 flagged for promotional pricing. This avoids competing on price against the new entrant (which would hurt margin and retention) and instead improves the core funnel. A standard experiment on simplified onboarding targets the measurable decline directly, is lower-risk than promotional pricing, and aligns with the primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue. We preserve the option to layer activation_messaging (memory_91) if onboarding lift alone proves insufficient.
